name: forge
description: A status board in a pane beside the chat: this session's subagents, today's schedule, and your GitHub work

githubOrgs.title: GitHub orgs
githubOrgs.description: Comma-separated GitHub orgs or users to search for your PRs, reviews and issues. Empty searches all of GitHub.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the schedule, the clock and day or night in the banner, such as Europe/Berlin. Empty uses this computer's time zone.

timeZoneLabel.title: Time zone label
timeZoneLabel.description: The short name shown next to times, such as CET. Empty uses this computer's short name, or the time zone itself when you set one.

repoShortNames.title: Repo short names
repoShortNames.description: Comma-separated owner/repo=name pairs that shorten long repository names in the pane.
